# Code of Conduct

Swarlex Manager is a small project run in people's free time. To keep it a good place to ask questions and
help each other:

- **Be kind and patient.** Many people opening an issue are not developers. Explain, do not belittle.
- **Stay on topic.** Issues and pull requests are about Swarlex Manager.
- **No harassment.** No insults, personal attacks, discrimination, or unwanted sexual content, in any form.
- **No harmful content.** Do not post malware, account or token stealers, piracy, or other people's private
  information. Discussions about building such things are closed and their authors may be blocked.
- **Respect the upstream projects.** Problems with Vencord, Spicetify or Millennium themselves belong in
  their own repositories.

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove comments, close issues and block accounts that break these rules.

To report a problem privately, use
[GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/swarlex/SwarlexManager/security/advisories/new) or the
*Report content* option on the comment in question.
